purpose: Published N-limited growth rates with the N2 flow, RF power and aperture plate that produced them. scripts/nitrogen_output_evidence.py back-calculates, with the repository's plate model and a bracketed geometry, the fraction eta of the feed's N atoms that left the plate as growth-active N. These are inferences under stated geometric assumptions, not measurements of eta.

conventions.flow: sccm of N2 (273.15 K, 101325 Pa); 1 sccm = 8.956e17 N atoms/s
conventions.rate: N-limited (metal-rich) growth rate at the substrate centre, um/h, as published
conventions.material_note: Wurtzite, from a and c: GaN 3.189 / 5.185 A, InN 3.537 / 5.704 A (two formula units per cell). The growth model's GaN atom rate (gan_growth.json units) is scaled by N density for InN.

GT_Riber32.description: Georgia Tech Riber 32 MBE, Veeco UNI-Bulb RF source, cryo-pumped (one CTI-8 and two CTI-10 during growth after the modification), growth pressure below 1e-4 Torr at more than 30 sccm
GT_Riber32.source: R26 section II-III.A; R30 section II

throw_m.note: Not published. Bracket: a compact research chamber to the 10.5 inch typical of a plasma source (H02).

source_polar_deg.note: Angle between the source axis and the substrate normal; not published.

GT_Riber32.substrate: 1 x 1 cm or 2 inch; rate taken as the centre value

MIB_HDRS.description: University of Milan-Bicocca MBE, Hakuto HDRS RF source, substrate not rotating, rate at the pyrometer spot (about 5 mm)
MIB_HDRS.substrate: GaN/sapphire template; rate at the pyrometer spot

R13_modified.source: R13 aperture table; R26 'custom 5.6x higher conductance aperture'

HDRS_unknown.note: Plate not published; bracketed with the L/r 0-5.8 range of the other plates

points.locator: R26 section III.B: flow 3-17 sccm at 350 W, then 350-500 W at 15 sccm, 'resulted in growth rates of 1.5 um/h to 6.1 um/h'
points.assignment: assumed: the 6.1 um/h end belongs to 15 sccm, 500 W (the end of the power series; Fig. 1 not digitized)

points.locator: R26 section III.B: 'Under this same condition using 20 sccm nitrogen without argon, the growth rate dropped to 8.2 um/h'
R26 section III.B: 'pure nitrogen at 500 W RF power and increasing the flow to 34 sccm ... 8.4 um/h'
R13 aperture table (PDF p. 9): 'Old Condition 712 holes, 1.3 sccm and ~1.3 um/hour'
points.assignment: approximate ('~'); pumping before the added cryo pumps

points.locator: R30 section III: '350 W and 2.5 sccm nitrogen flow resulted in a growth rate of 2.01 um/hr'
R30 section III: '550 W with 2.5 sccm ... increased the growth rate up to 2.54 um/hr'
R30 section III: 'nitrogen flow as high as 7.5 sccm, the resulting growth rate was 4.58 um/hr'
R12 section 3, Fig. 4: 3 sccm, 300 W, 'GaN growth rate of 11.92 +/- 0.01 nm/min' (N-limited, Ga-rich, no Ga desorption at 600 C)

direct_source_measurements.statement: SVTA RF4.5 source, single exit aperture: dissociation fraction up to 0.4 (about 0.1 Torr source pressure) and total atomic flux up to 0.85e18 atoms/s (about 0.3 Torr)
direct_source_measurements.use: An absolute output scale for a production source of that era: 0.85e18 atoms/s is a fifth of what layout B needs for 1 um/h on 200 mm (4.7e18)

direct_source_measurements.statement: RF nitrogen atom source: 18 % dissociation at 400 W; up to 0.7 at very low N2 flow, falling as the flow rises
direct_source_measurements.use: Dissociation is high only at low flow, where the absolute output is small
